page_title: NIC 2-0 LEN | Nice v Lens 20/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Hakim Ben El Hadj is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' Morgan Guilavogui (Lens) picked up a yellow card from referee.
90+5' Elye Wahi (Lens) is caught offside!
90+4' Hakim Ben El Hadj shows a yellow card to Dante (Nice) for a tough tackle.
90+4' Nice are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
90+3' The current number of shots on goal is 5:2.
90+1' 7 additional min. will be played.
89' Substitution. Hicham Boudaoui walks off the pitch and Romain Perraud (Nice) comes on as a substitute.
88' Francesco Farioli has decided to substitute Jeremie Boga and he is replaced by Tom Louchet (Nice).
88' Abdukodir Khusanov (Lens) is yellow-carded.
85' Lens will take a corner kick.
85' Antoine Mendy comes off the pitch to be replaced by Alexis Claude-Maurice (Nice).
84' Corner kick. Lens will have an opportunity.
82' That's the end of the game for Neil El Aynaoui, who is replaced by Oscar Cortes (Lens).
82' Franck Haise prepares a substitution. Florian Sotoca is replaced by Morgan Guilavogui (Lens).
78' 2 - 0 It's a goal! Terem Moffi (Nice) gets on the end of a pass and it allows him to finish into an empty net with a close-range header. The score has changed to 2:0.
76' 1 - 0 Goal! Terem Moffi (Nice) puts the penalty low into the middle of the goal and past Brice Samba.
76' Terem Moffi (Nice) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
75' Salis Abdul Samed (Lens) was too forceful with his tackle and Hakim Ben El Hadj interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Nice are about to take a penalty!
74' Here comes a substitution. Elye Wahi (Lens) is brought on as a substitute for Wesley Said.
74' The manager has decided to make a substitution and David Costa walks off the pitch to be replaced by Andy Diouf (Lens).
74' Franck Haise decides to make a substitution. Przemyslaw Frankowski will be replaced by Angelo Fulgini (Lens).
73' Gaetan Laborde will be replaced by Terem Moffi (Nice).
73' The free kick from long range, taken by Lens, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
72' Hakim Ben El Hadj blows for a foul after Gaetan Laborde (Nice) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Lens will take a free kick.
71' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
70' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 40:60.
69' Massadio Haidara (Lens) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
68' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) tackles a bit over-zealously and Hakim Ben El Hadj blows for a foul.
66' David Costa (Lens) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
66' Marcin Bulka (Nice) is able to continue to play.
64' Marcin Bulka (Nice) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
63' Dante (Nice) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Hakim Ben El Hadj blows his whistle for an infringement. Lens are awarded the free kick.

61' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
58' David Costa (Lens) unleashed a brilliant free kick from the edge of the box and hits the left post of the goal.
57' The ball goes behind for a corner. Nice will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
56' Referee Hakim Ben El Hadj sees the trip by Antoine Mendy (Nice) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Lens earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
55' Flag up against Hicham Boudaoui (Nice). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
51' A weak shot from the edge of the box by Gaetan Laborde (Nice) is easily saved by Brice Samba.
48' Florian Sotoca (Lens) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
48' Nice force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
47' Jeremie Boga (Nice) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Nice.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
45+1' We will have 5 min. of added time.
45' Good work from Nice as they win a corner.
43' The ball is cleared after Melvin Bard (Nice) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
42' Poor challenge! Salis Abdul Samed (Lens) is penalised for tripping and Hakim Ben El Hadj blows his whistle.
40' Nice players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
38' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Florian Sotoca (Lens) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
36' The linesman makes the right call and Lens will have a corner.
34' The total number of attempts is 4:3.
33' Wesley Said (Lens) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong. The ball goes out of play and Nice will have a goal kick.
31' Evann Guessand (Nice) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Brice Samba pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
29' A cross from Gaetan Laborde (Nice) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
28' Wesley Said (Lens) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nice.
26' The game is interrupted. Jordan Lotomba (Nice) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
24' Evann Guessand (Nice) commits a foul and Hakim Ben El Hadj immediately signals a free kick.
23' Morgan Sanson (Nice) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
22' David Costa (Lens) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Marcin Bulka has no trouble gathering it.

22' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The ball goes out of play. Lens are awarded a corner kick.
20' The corner is swung in but Nice can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
20' Melvin Bard (Nice) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Nice get a corner.
18' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
16' The resulting set piece from Nice is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
16' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender. The linesman points to the corner flag, Nice are going to take it.
14' Hakim Ben El Hadj blows his whistle and it's Melvin Bard (Nice) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
14' David Costa (Lens) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
13' Wesley Said (Lens) bends a great shot in from the edge of the box, but Marcin Bulka makes a smart save to deny him. The ball goes out of play. Lens are awarded a corner kick.
13' Evann Guessand (Nice) jumps into a tackle and Hakim Ben El Hadj signals a foul.
10' Dante (Nice) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header directed towards the goal is brilliantly saved by the goalkeeper.
10' Morgan Sanson (Nice) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
8' Dangerous play by Facundo Medina (Lens). Hakim Ben El Hadj blows his whistle for a foul.
7' Nice are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
6' The game gets underway again after that interruption.
1' The game is interrupted.
1' The first half has just begun.
Nice will kick the game off.
Hakim Ben El Hadj will officiate today.
